name: Template contract
purpose: Checks each universal policy file of a UOR template repository against its locked digest. Send the six expected and observed digests; it answers conformant, or names every file that drifted, and invalid request for anything else.

promise.headline: Says conformant exactly when every policy file matches its lock.
promise.detail: Each of the six universal policy files is compared with the digest the lock records, and any file that drifted is named.

claim: TC-01: the checker answers conformant exactly when every universal policy file's observed digest equals its locked digest.

proposition.name: Conformant
proposition.text:
Conformant observation :=
  SameDigest devcontainer.expected devcontainer.observed
  /\ SameDigest bootstrap.expected bootstrap.observed
  /\ SameDigest agents.expected agents.observed
  /\ SameDigest verification.expected verification.observed
  /\ SameDigest prismpmLock.expected prismpmLock.observed
  /\ SameDigest templateContract.expected templateContract.observed

SameDigest left right :=
  left.w0 = right.w0 /\ left.w1 = right.w1 /\ left.w2 = right.w2 /\ left.w3 = right.w3
proposition.plain: Every one of the six universal policy files has the digest the lock says it has.

theorems.name: conformant_decides
theorems.statement: conformant observation = true ↔ Conformant observation, for every observation
theorems.how: Proved by simplification over the record fields, checked by the Lean kernel by prismpm verify in CI

pinned.name: contract_tc_01
pinned.what: The theorem's statement and axioms, the six files the proposition names against template-contract.json, that a drifted file is named in the verdict, and that the verdict is decided by conformant. A string-matching test, not a theorem: a planted defect fails it.
